introduction: Dig into the strategies employed by sports betting apps to keep you gambling, and how these tactics

vocabulary.definition: to risk money on the result of an event or a competition, such as a game or a race
vocabulary.example: Spectators around the globe wagered an estimated $35 billion on the World Cup.

vocabulary.definition: relating to the characteristics of a particular population, especially with regard to age, race, and gender
vocabulary.example: Young people in their early 20s make up the fastest-growing gambling demographic.

vocabulary.definition: attracting or tempting someone to do something by offering pleasure or advantage
vocabulary.example: Infrequent wins are a key reason why gambling can feel so enticing.

vocabulary.definition: a chemical substance that is released at the end of a nerve fiber by the arrival of a nerve impulse and that causes the transfer of the impulse to another nerve fiber, a muscle fiber, or some other structure
vocabulary.example: Dopamine is a neurotransmitter that mediates feelings of pleasure in the brain.

vocabulary.definition: a series of bets in which the winnings from one bet are used as a stake for the subsequent bets
vocabulary.example: Parlays in sports betting involve tying bets on multiple events into the same wager.

vocabulary.definition: susceptible to physical or emotional attack or harm
vocabulary.example: Teens are more vulnerable to developing gambling problems due to the rapid maturation of reward regions in their brains.
